title: Headless Dead Money fail branch (DeadMoney.esm): part 1 to the three Act 2 jobs, Dog killed (Fires in the Sky, NVDLC01MQ02a 255) and Dean killed (Trigger the Gala Event, NVDLC01MQ02 255); docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: The first part is the Dead Money chain's own (dead-money.actions.json), part 1; this branch kills Dog and Dean once Elijah has handed out the three Act 2 jobs (fight stand-in: kill, the player as killer): Dog's OnDeath fails Fires in the Sky (NVDLC01MQ02a 255) and Dean's, with Strike Up the Band running, fails Trigger the Gala Event (NVDLC01MQ02 255). It ends there.

Starts after the base game's opening: VCG01 done, and the reference that the trigger outside Doc Mitchell's house enables is enabled (the add-on's start quest waits for it). Message boxes hold the game (given menu 1001 closed); each box is closed as the player's OK would.
NVDLC01MQ00 (start game enabled) waits 30 s after that reference is enabled, then sets stage 10: the broadcast message, the bunker's door unlocked and its map marker shown.

Travel to the abandoned bunker (stand-in) and walk to the radio at its far end: the player stands in its trigger (OnTrigger, physics sensors stand in). It sets MQ00 100, gasses the player, takes the gear into a container and after the timers starts NVDLC01Intro, which moves the player into the slide room.

actions.label: milestone: NVDLC01MQ00 100 (Sierra Madre Grand Opening! done)

actions.text: The player lands in the slide room's trigger (physics sensors stand in): the narrator's SayTo chain says every opening slide; the last one's SayToDone starts the Villa transition timer, which moves the player to the Villa's start marker.

actions.label: opening slides said, Villa transition started

actions.text: The start marker is by the Villa fountain; the player stands in the fountain's trigger. It starts NVDLC01FountainStartSequence, whose timer starts NVDLC01MQ01 at stage 5 (the collar, the jumpsuit and the holorifle) and activates Elijah's hologram.

The sequence activates Elijah's hologram (a talking activator) on the player's behalf. Its conversation opens through it (a script's activation by the player opens the talk, as the play loop does). The player asks the first questions and takes the goodbye that starts the three collar quests.
Find Collar 8: Dog (NVDLC01MQ01a). Travel to the police station (stand-in); the player stands in the trigger by Dog's cell (stage 20).

The police station's ham radios jam the collar (two of them are in range where travel puts the player; the collar starts beeping). The player switches all four off by hand (their OnActivate), as a player would before the long talk; travel by MoveTo would otherwise leave the player counted inside their radius (the radios' distance check runs only while their cell is loaded) and the collar would go off later.

actions.label: collar quiet at the police station

actions.text: The player picks up Dog's command holotape: the quest script sees the note (stage 30).

The player plays the tape near Dog (still in the trigger). The tape is a Voice note whose line's end script turns Dog into God and sets stage 40. The runner's play_note runs the line's scripts (hard stall in the game: nvf-play's holotape player plays the voice only and does not yet call Game::holotape_script).

That end script gives Dog a dialogue package whose topic is God's first greeting; its conversation is started here with the package's topic (soft stall: dialogue packages start no conversation headless).

The player asks God about the cage and its key and what controls Dog, then talks God into letting Dog out (iDogCage 1); Dog comes back, the player asks Dog to come along and the goodbye sets stage 100.

Find Collar 14: Dean Domino (NVDLC01MQ01b). Travel to Dean's hideout (stand-in). Dean starts his first conversation when the player sits in the chair inside his trigger (GetSitting 3). Stand-in: the trigger's first-conversation flag is set and the conversation started (soft stall: the runner has no op for the player sitting on furniture). His greeting sets stage 20.
The player listens to Dean's terms, agrees to the job and asks him along; the goodbye opens the residential gate and sets stage 100.
Dean comes along as the player's companion: his perk's message box is closed as the player's OK would.

actions.label: milestone: NVDLC01MQ01b 100 (Find Collar 14: Dean Domino done)

actions.text: Find Collar 12: Christine (NVDLC01MQ01c). Travel to the clinic (stand-in); the player stands in the trigger in the clinic's corridor (stage 20) and switches off the speakers at the basement terminal (stage 30).

A player reaches the basement through the clinic's main floor, whose two collar speakers then start up (their first GameMode frame) and fall out of range as the player goes down. Travel skips that floor, so it is loaded here while the player is downstairs; otherwise its speakers would start up only after the terminal has switched them off, undoing it.

Christine, out of the auto-doc, greets the player (stage 40 at the greeting's end). The player answers her signs kindly (her attitude +1; with Act 2's +1 she is an ally in the suites) and asks her along; the goodbye sets stage 100, which starts Fires in the Sky (NVDLC01MQ02a 5), whose stage closes MQ01.

Act 2. Back at the fountain (travel stand-in) the player talks to Elijah's hologram (conversation started by hand, as before) and takes the goodbye that hands out the three jobs: MQ02a, MQ02b and MQ02c 10; the hired companion is sent to their post.

actions.label: milestone: the three Act 2 jobs given (MQ02a 10)
milestone: Fires in the Sky failed (Dog dead, 255)
milestone: Trigger the Gala Event failed (Dean dead, 255)
